content: We use two different sets of vocabulary for our experiments. For the subword experiments, both English and German vocabularies are generated using sentencepiece BIBREF15 with a fixed size of 5k tokens. BIBREF9 inaguma2018speech show that increasing the vocabulary size is not helpful for ST task. For the character experiments, both English and German sentences are represented in the character level.
